# Automatic replies

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Away message and opening hours

- **What it is:** An automatic reply outside office hours, with hours per day and dated exceptions.
- **Plan:** Every plan. It applies to every number, goes once per closed period, and can also answer leads from ads.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Automatic replies > Away message > Enable away message
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/automatic-replies.md, section "away-message". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/automatic-replies#away-message

## Keep the 24-hour window open

- **What it is:** One automatic follow-up sent before the 24-hour window closes.
- **Plan:** Every plan. It sends whether or not the customer replied.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Automatic replies > Keep window open > Enable keep window open
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/automatic-replies.md, section "keep-window-open". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/automatic-replies#keep-window-open

## Create or edit saved replies

- **What it is:** Ready-made texts the team inserts in the composer. They are not templates.
- **Plan:** Every plan.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins create them. Anyone inserts one with / in the composer.
- **Where:** Settings > Automatic replies > Saved replies > Create saved reply
- **The agent can:** read them with `list_saved_replies`
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/automatic-replies.md, section "saved-replies". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/automatic-replies#saved-replies

## Send a follow-up only if there is no reply

- **What it is:** A scheduled message that sends only if the person has not replied, or only if labels still match.
- **Plan:** Work, Growth, Pro, Agency, the 14-day trial and the Free plan.
- **Who can do it:** The docs name no role: anyone who schedules a message in the inbox sets it.
- **Where:** Inbox > the clock in the composer > Send only if
- **The agent can:** schedule it with `schedule_message` and its `send_if`
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/conditional-follow-ups.md, section "where-you-set-it". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/conditional-follow-ups#where-you-set-it
